source_text: Similar results emerged from trials in Kisumu, Kenya (2002-2005, n=2,784 men, 51% reduction) and Rakai, Uganda (2002-2007, n=4,996 men, 55% reduction), confirming the protective effect against HIV-1 while showing no significant behavioral risk compensation. [90]
